name: std::atomic<T>::operator T
intro:
Atomically loads and returns the current value of the atomic variable. Equivalent to load().

It is deprecated if std::atomic<T>::is_always_lock_free is false and overload (2) participates in overload resolution.


(since C++20)

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The current value of the atomic variable.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: A shared counter starts at 4, then receives 8, 10, and 12.
